name: Galatia
overview: The region of Galatia was a significant area in the early spread of the gospel, as Paul traveled extensively through its cities, strengthening the disciples and establishing churches (Acts 16:6; 18:23). The epistle to the Galatians is addressed specifically to these churches, emphasizing Paul's apostolic authority given by Jesus Christ and God the Father (Galatians 1:1-2). This highlights the importance of Galatian churches in the early Christian mission and their connection to the wider body of believers.
